# visualization.design_stats.design_correlations { #fmrimod.visualization.design_stats.design_correlations }

```python
design_correlations(model, method='pearson', within_run=False)
```

Correlations between the design columns of ``model``.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type                                     | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | Default     |
|------------|------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| model      | (EventModel, BaselineModel or FmriModel) |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | _required_  |
| method     | (\'pearson\', \'spearman\')              |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | `"pearson"` |
| within_run | bool or None                             | ``False``: across all scans with runs concatenated. ``True``: run intercepts dropped, columns centred within runs, run-specific columns correlated on their own run (pairs from different runs are NaN). ``None`` picks ``True`` for a baseline model. | `False`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type             | Description                                                                            |
|--------|------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | pandas.DataFrame | Square, labelled by the columns' display labels; NaN where a correlation is undefined. |
